title: sendgrid-python send() hangs forever when the SendGrid API stalls
symptoms: Worker or request thread stuck inside sg.send(message)
No exception and no response during a network blip
Batch jobs stop partway with no error logged
cause: SendGridAPIClient.send takes no timeout and the underlying urllib call defaults to none, so a stalled connection blocks indefinitely. The lower-level client does accept a per-call timeout.
fix: Call the lower-level client with an explicit timeout instead of send().
